You can wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3830320/Ballgame/ You can also try the demo if you're interested: https://huco.click/demo

In a tiny pocket universe, tucked away at the edge of our own, there is a hotel for lost balls. Little balls, big balls, any balls, really. In this miniature golfing adventure, you don't hit the ball, you are the ball. Explore a tiny handcrafted world from tee to flag. 

Compete in suspicious underground tournaments for glory and pennies. Race through fiendish heists at the whim of a cosmic magpie. Did we mention hats?

#IGN #IGNLive #SummerOfGaming
title: Ballgame - Official Story Trailer - IGN Live 2026

Meet the characters and voice cast of Over Requiemz in this latest trailer for the upcoming otome adventure based on The Wizard of Oz. The Over Requiemz trailer also unveils the opening theme song called "Muted Expectations," featuring vocals by Hisano and composition/arrangement by Mari, along with a release date reveal. Over Requiemz will be available on Nintendo Switch on August 20, 2026.

In Over Requiemz, high school student Yuhiru is swept up in a mysterious tornado and finds herself lost in Oz. There, she is unjustly sentenced to death and ordered to travel with four convicts on death row and their supervisor. Their goal? Mysterious ruins that look like home, only dilapidated and infested with monsters. At the mercy of her fellow travelers, Yuhiru will face many hard decisions along the way. But there’s one thing she must bear in mind: No one is lost forever, no matter how far they’ve strayed.

author: IGN
description:
Dan Stevens, who also serves as executive producer, stars as Pepper – a working-class moving man who, through a combination of bad luck and a bad temper, finds himself wrongfully committed to New Hyde Psychiatric Hospital – an institution filled with those society would rather forget. There, he must contend with patients working against him, doctors harboring grim secrets, and perhaps even the Devil himself. 

As Pepper navigates a hellscape where nothing is as it seems, he finds that the only path to freedom is to face the entity which thrives on the suffering within New Hyde’s walls – but doing so may prove that the worst demons of all live inside him. 

AMC+ and Shudder's six-episode limited series is also executive produced by Ridley Scott, writers and showrunners Chris Cantwell (Halt and Catch Fire) and Victor LaValle (The Changeling), author of the celebrated novel on which the season is based, and Emmy nominee Karyn Kusama (Yellowjackets).

AMC+ and Shudder's six-episode limited series is also executive produced by Ridley Scott, writers and showrunners Chris Cantwell (Halt and Catch Fire) and Victor LaValle (The Changeling), author of the celebrated novel on which the season is based, and Emmy nominee Karyn Kusama (Yellowjackets).
